metrics.label: Expectancy
metrics.definition: Mean closed net R
metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Median outcome

metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Win rate

metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Average winner

metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Average loser

metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Payoff ratio

metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Profit factor (R)
metrics.definition: Sum positive net R / absolute sum negative net R
metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Total R

metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Best trade

metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Worst trade

metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Top five winners contribution

metrics.limitations: Equal-risk observations; not portfolio profit. Undefined denominators remain unavailable.

metrics.label: Closed-trade drawdown
metrics.definition: Largest decline from a peak of cumulative closed net R, starting at zero
metrics.limitations: Ordered by exit date then stable trade ID; intraday sequence unknown. Breakeven resets streaks. Excursions use pre-exit bars and known open/exit prices, not the full exit-bar path.

metrics.label: Longest winning streak

metrics.label: Longest losing streak

metrics.label: Average holding time
metrics.definition: Mean recorded holding sessions of closed trades with values
metrics.limitations: Ordered by exit date then stable trade ID; intraday sequence unknown. Breakeven resets streaks. Excursions use pre-exit bars and known open/exit prices, not the full exit-bar path.

metrics.label: Average MFE (conservative)
metrics.definition: Mean recorded MFE of closed trades with values
metrics.limitations: Ordered by exit date then stable trade ID; intraday sequence unknown. Breakeven resets streaks. Excursions use pre-exit bars and known open/exit prices, not the full exit-bar path.

metrics.label: Average MAE (conservative)
metrics.definition: Mean recorded MAE of closed trades with values
metrics.limitations: Ordered by exit date then stable trade ID; intraday sequence unknown. Breakeven resets streaks. Excursions use pre-exit bars and known open/exit prices, not the full exit-bar path.

metrics.label: Prior ADV20
metrics.definition: Mean volume over the 20 authoritative sessions immediately before setup; excludes setup.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: ATR14
metrics.definition: Wilder ATR14: mean of first 14 valid prior-close true ranges; subsequent ATR=(13*prior ATR+TR)/14. TR=max(high-low, abs(high-previous close), abs(low-previous close)). Resets after missing sessions.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: ATR %
metrics.definition: 100 * ATR14 / close.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: Body / ATR
metrics.definition: abs(close-open) / ATR14.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: Setup close
metrics.definition: Recorded setup-session close on the immutable run price and volume basis.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: Close location
metrics.definition: (close-low)/(high-low); null for a zero-range bar.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: Distance from 252-session high
metrics.definition: 100 * (close / highest high in the 252 sessions ending at setup - 1). Requires all 252 bars.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: Distance from post-EP high
metrics.definition: (highest high from EP through setup - setup close) / setup ATR14.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: Distance from SMA20
metrics.definition: (close-SMA20) / ATR14.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: Distribution days
metrics.definition: Number of post-EP sessions meeting the saved distribution rule; null if any post-EP bar is missing. Reconstructed episode v1 uses previous close-close >= 0.75*prior ATR14 and volume>previous volume.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: Prior dollar volume20
metrics.definition: Mean(close*volume) over 20 sessions immediately before setup; excludes setup.
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: EP age

metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: EP return
metrics.definition: 100 * (EP close / previous authoritative session close - 1).
metrics.limitations: Recorded source scan only; never recalculated using later data. Missing inputs remain unavailable. Price adjustment and historical universe biases are inherited from the frozen run.

metrics.label: EP volume expansion
